description.narrative: The project will foster commercialization of agriculture through interventions to promote diversification into high-value crops (HVCs) and value addition, gender mainstreaming, and climate change adaptation. The project is market oriented and demand driven, and will increase farmers' incomes and enhance food security in Bangladesh.

The outcome will be improved efficiency and value addition of HVC production. The direct beneficiaries will be marginal, small and medium farmers with landholdings up to 3 hectares. Landless people will benefit through generated employment opportunities in rural areas.

Improved quantity, quality, regularity, and value of HVCs in response to market demand, and public health and environmental requirements Progress/Status: Group formation ongoing. NGO-BRAC in coordination with DAE is forming new farmer groups. DAE is organizing Village based technical training for these groups to make them eligible for credit support.
